newsitem.title: UK: Airtours shares tumble on OFT probe.
newsitem.headline: Airtours shares tumble on OFT probe.

text.p: Shares in Airtours Plc dropped on Thursday after the Office of Fair Trading said it would investigate package holiday selling by travel agents.
The stock was down 33p at 680 by 1036 GMT.
The OFT said it was instigating monopolies' investigations into the supply of foreign holidays and the supply of travel agency services in relation to such holidays.
It also said the reference would allow the Monopolies and Mergers Commission to look into links between tour operators and travel agents.
No one at Airtours was immediately available to comment.
One analyst said he did not believe the market was over reacting. "It's certainly not good. We just don't know how the investigation will affect the industry or the company," said one.
